title: Placeholder type
summary: PowerPoint's placeholder type as its layout matches it: ctrTitle reads as title, obj (or none) as body.

title: Index
summary: PowerPoint's placeholder idx, the key a slide's placeholder matches its layout's by.

title: Frame
summary: The core page item that fills the placeholder: the address frame paths and bindings target.

title: Text
summary: The placeholder's text (its story); \n splits paragraphs. Absent on a placeholder that holds no text frame.
